paragraphs.text: Najeela , known as the Blade-Blossom , is a legendary human warrior from the plane of Kylem .

Najeela is a human warrior who fights in the stadium of Valor's Reach on Kylem. She is an olive-skinned female with long red hair and silver metal armor. Likely contributing to her epithet she wears two flowers in her hair and wields two slightly curved silver blades as weapons.
